Setup, software connections and recovery.

Contact the project

Common issues

Build or installation

Check the exact build, publisher and requirements. Keep Windows protection enabled. Blocked or withdrawn builds need a qualified replacement, not a protection bypass.

Read the guide

Your local workspace

Choose a folder you can access and write to. Reconnect an unavailable removable drive before retrying. Preserve original customer files.

Read the guide

Unknown operation outcome

Keep the original operation reference and read the recovered status before retrying. Cancellation does not prove a native change was undone.

Read the guide

Safe diagnostics

Share the page or build, host version, failed step and a redacted error. Keep passwords, codes, tokens and confidential project content out of messages.

Read the guide

Account support

Account-linked support is not available yet. No ticket is created here.

Account sign-in

Email opens your email app. Nothing is sent until you send it.
